TLP_ENABLE.description: Set to 0 to disable, 1 to enable TLP.

TLP_WARN_LEVEL.description: Control how warnings about invalid settings are issued.

TLP_MSG_COLORS.description: Colorize error, warning, notice and success messages.

TLP_DEFAULT_MODE.description: Operation mode when no power supply can be detected.

TLP_PS_IGNORE.description: Power supply classes to ignore when determining operation mode.

DISK_IDLE_SECS_ON_AC.description: Seconds laptop mode has to wait after the disk goes idle before doing a sync (AC).

DISK_IDLE_SECS_ON_BAT.description: Seconds laptop mode has to wait after the disk goes idle before doing a sync (BAT).

CPU_SCALING_GOVERNOR_ON_AC.description: Select a CPU frequency scaling governor (AC).

CPU_SCALING_GOVERNOR_ON_BAT.description: Select a CPU frequency scaling governor (BAT).

CPU_SCALING_MIN_FREQ_ON_AC.description: Set the min frequency available for the scaling governor (AC).

CPU_SCALING_MAX_FREQ_ON_AC.description: Set the max frequency available for the scaling governor (AC).

CPU_SCALING_MIN_FREQ_ON_BAT.description: Set the min frequency available for the scaling governor (BAT).

CPU_SCALING_MAX_FREQ_ON_BAT.description: Set the max frequency available for the scaling governor (BAT).

CPU_ENERGY_PERF_POLICY_ON_AC.description: Set CPU energy/performance policies EPP and EPB (AC).

CPU_ENERGY_PERF_POLICY_ON_BAT.description: Set CPU energy/performance policies EPP and EPB (BAT).

CPU_MIN_PERF_ON_AC.description: Set Intel CPU P-state performance min (AC).

CPU_MAX_PERF_ON_AC.description: Set Intel CPU P-state performance max (AC).

CPU_MIN_PERF_ON_BAT.description: Set Intel CPU P-state performance min (BAT).

CPU_MAX_PERF_ON_BAT.description: Set Intel CPU P-state performance max (BAT).

CPU_BOOST_ON_AC.description: Set the CPU turbo boost feature (AC).

CPU_BOOST_ON_BAT.description: Set the CPU turbo boost feature (BAT).

DISK_DEVICES.description: Define disk devices on which DISK/AHCI_RUNTIME parameters act.

DISK_APM_CLASS_DENYLIST.description: Exclude disk classes from advanced power management (APM).

DISK_IOSCHED.description: Select I/O scheduler for the disk devices.

SATA_LINKPWR_ON_AC.description: AHCI link power management (ALPM) for SATA disks (AC).

SATA_LINKPWR_ON_BAT.description: AHCI link power management (ALPM) for SATA disks (BAT).

SATA_LINKPWR_DENYLIST.description: Exclude SATA links from AHCI link power management (ALPM).

AHCI_RUNTIME_PM_ON_AC.description: Runtime Power Management for NVMe, SATA, ATA and USB disks (AC).

AHCI_RUNTIME_PM_ON_BAT.description: Runtime Power Management for NVMe, SATA, ATA and USB disks (BAT).

AHCI_RUNTIME_PM_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds of inactivity before disk is suspended.

BAY_POWEROFF_ON_AC.description: Power off optical drive in UltraBay/MediaBay (AC).

BAY_POWEROFF_ON_BAT.description: Power off optical drive in UltraBay/MediaBay (BAT).

BAY_DEVICE.description: Optical drive device to power off.

INTEL_GPU_MIN_FREQ_ON_AC.description: Set the min frequency for the Intel GPU (AC).

INTEL_GPU_MIN_FREQ_ON_BAT.description: Set the min frequency for the Intel GPU (BAT).

INTEL_GPU_MAX_FREQ_ON_AC.description: Set the max frequency for the Intel GPU (AC).

INTEL_GPU_MAX_FREQ_ON_BAT.description: Set the max frequency for the Intel GPU (BAT).

INTEL_GPU_BOOST_FREQ_ON_AC.description: Set the turbo frequency for the Intel GPU (AC).

INTEL_GPU_BOOST_FREQ_ON_BAT.description: Set the turbo frequency for the Intel GPU (BAT).

RADEON_DPM_PERF_LEVEL_ON_AC.description: AMD GPU power management performance level (AC).

RADEON_DPM_PERF_LEVEL_ON_BAT.description: AMD GPU power management performance level (BAT).

RADEON_DPM_STATE_ON_AC.description: Dynamic power management method (DPM) for radeon driver (AC).

RADEON_DPM_STATE_ON_BAT.description: Dynamic power management method (DPM) for radeon driver (BAT).

AMDGPU_ABM_LEVEL_ON_AC.description: Display panel adaptive backlight modulation (ABM) level (AC).

AMDGPU_ABM_LEVEL_ON_BAT.description: Display panel adaptive backlight modulation (ABM) level (BAT).

SOUND_POWER_SAVE_ON_AC.description: Enable audio power saving for Intel HDA, AC97 devices (AC).

SOUND_POWER_SAVE_ON_BAT.description: Enable audio power saving for Intel HDA, AC97 devices (BAT).

RUNTIME_PM_ON_AC.description: Runtime Power Management for PCIe bus devices (AC).

RUNTIME_PM_ON_BAT.description: Runtime Power Management for PCIe bus devices (BAT).

RUNTIME_PM_DENYLIST.description: Exclude listed PCIe device adresses from Runtime PM.

RUNTIME_PM_DRIVER_DENYLIST.description: Exclude PCIe devices assigned to the listed drivers from Runtime PM.

RUNTIME_PM_ENABLE.description: Permanently enable Runtime PM for listed PCIe device addresses.

RUNTIME_PM_DISABLE.description: Permanently disable Runtime PM for listed PCIe device addresses.

USB_AUTOSUSPEND.description: Set to 0 to disable, 1 to enable USB autosuspend feature.

USB_DENYLIST.description: Exclude listed devices from USB autosuspend.

USB_EXCLUDE_AUDIO.description: Exclude audio devices from USB autosuspend.

USB_EXCLUDE_BTUSB.description: Exclude bluetooth devices from USB autosuspend.

USB_EXCLUDE_PHONE.description: Exclude phone devices from USB autosuspend.

USB_EXCLUDE_WWAN.description: Exclude WWAN devices from USB autosuspend.

USB_ALLOWLIST.description: Allow USB autosuspend for listed devices even if already denylisted or excluded.

RESTORE_DEVICE_STATE_ON_STARTUP.description: Restore radio device state from previous shutdown on system startup.

DEVICES_TO_DISABLE_ON_STARTUP.description: Radio devices to disable on startup.

DEVICES_TO_ENABLE_ON_STARTUP.description: Radio devices to enable on startup.

DEVICES_TO_ENABLE_ON_AC.description: Radio devices to enable on AC.

DEVICES_TO_DISABLE_ON_BAT.description: Radio devices to disable on battery.

DEVICES_TO_DISABLE_ON_BAT_NOT_IN_USE.description: Radio devices to disable on battery when not in use.

START_CHARGE_THRESH_BAT0.description: Battery charge level below which charging will begin (BAT0).

STOP_CHARGE_THRESH_BAT0.description: Battery charge level above which charging will stop (BAT0).

START_CHARGE_THRESH_BAT1.description: Battery charge level below which charging will begin (BAT1).

STOP_CHARGE_THRESH_BAT1.description: Battery charge level above which charging will stop (BAT1).

RESTORE_THRESHOLDS_ON_BAT.description: Restore charge thresholds when AC is unplugged.

DEVICES_TO_DISABLE_ON_LAN_CONNECT.description: Radio devices to disable on LAN connect.

DEVICES_TO_DISABLE_ON_WIFI_CONNECT.description: Radio devices to disable on WiFi connect.

DEVICES_TO_DISABLE_ON_WWAN_CONNECT.description: Radio devices to disable on WWAN connect.

DEVICES_TO_ENABLE_ON_LAN_DISCONNECT.description: Radio devices to enable on LAN disconnect.

DEVICES_TO_ENABLE_ON_WIFI_DISCONNECT.description: Radio devices to enable on WiFi disconnect.

DEVICES_TO_ENABLE_ON_WWAN_DISCONNECT.description: Radio devices to enable on WWAN disconnect.

DEVICES_TO_ENABLE_ON_DOCK.description: Radio devices to enable when docked.

DEVICES_TO_DISABLE_ON_DOCK.description: Radio devices to disable when docked.

DEVICES_TO_ENABLE_ON_UNDOCK.description: Radio devices to enable when undocked.

DEVICES_TO_DISABLE_ON_UNDOCK.description: Radio devices to disable when undocked.
